description: DYNAMIC watchlist — changes every day based on scanner results. No fixed symbols. Run scanner every morning before 15:30 Oslo to build fresh list of 3-5 stocks.
how_to_build: Run Finviz screener + check Warrior Trading penny stocks page + check Yahoo earnings calendar. Pick top 3-5 that score 5+ out of 9.

eu_high_volatility_candidates.description: EU ADR stocks in penny stock price range ($1-$20) that can gap on EU news. These trade on NYSE/NASDAQ so Finviz scanner covers them. Check EU news at London open (10:00 Oslo) — if any gapped >4% on catalyst, add to today's penny stock list.

assets.name: Stellantis
assets.note: EV news, labor disputes, earnings — very volatile

assets.name: Volkswagen
assets.note: EV transition, China sales, union news

assets.name: BASF
assets.note: Chemical demand, energy costs, EU industrial health

assets.name: Yara International
assets.note: Above $20 range but very volatile on fertilizer/food news

assets.name: Deutsche Bank
assets.note: Above range but gaps hard on ECB/financial stress news

eu_high_volatility_candidates.scanning_rule: At London open 10:00 Oslo, check if any EU ADR gapped >4% overnight with catalyst. If yes, add to today's penny stock candidates for NY open execution at 15:30.
